name: realtimesdk-platform
description: Framework-independent realtime rooms and messaging for browser clients and one Node.js server.
author: Eren2yeager

scripts.build: bun run --cwd packages/core build && bun run --cwd packages/server build && bun run --cwd packages/sfu build && bun run --cwd packages/client build && bun run --cwd packages/react build && bun run --cwd packages/express build && bun run --cwd packages/next build
scripts.test:smoke: bun tests/smoke/v0.1-smoke-test.mjs && bun tests/smoke/v0.2-smoke-test.mjs && bun tests/smoke/v0.3-smoke-test.mjs && bun tests/smoke/v0.4-smoke-test.mjs && bun tests/smoke/v0.5-express-smoke-test.mjs && bun tests/smoke/v0.5-next-smoke-test.mjs && bun tests/smoke/v0.6-group-call-smoke-test.mjs && node tests/smoke/v0.7-sfu-smoke-test.mjs && node tests/smoke/v0.7-client-sfu-smoke-test.mjs
scripts.changeset:publish: bun run build && bun run publish:all
scripts.publish:all: bun publish --cwd packages/core --access public --tag latest && bun publish --cwd packages/server --access public --tag latest && bun publish --cwd packages/sfu --access public --tag latest && bun publish --cwd packages/client --access public --tag latest && bun publish --cwd packages/react --access public --tag latest && bun publish --cwd packages/express --access public --tag latest && bun publish --cwd packages/next --access public --tag latest
